#   myip.ms › cPanel / ConfigServer Firewall
#   
#   List of IP addresses within the last 10 days that have been confirmed by
#   myip.ms to be bots / malicious.
#   
#   Compatible with cPanel and CSF Firewall.
#   
#   Notes for CSF Firewall: 
#       Add/Replace Blacklist IPs in /etc/csf/csf.deny
#       DENY_IP_LIMIT       Max number of IPs that can be saved in /etc/csf/csf.deny
#                           (default: 100)
#   
#       To Increase Limit   [WHM]       Plugins => Configserver Security &
#                                       firewall => Firewall configuration 
#                           
#                           [MANUAL     Edit => /etc/csf/csf.conf; change value. 
#                                       DENY_IP_LIMIT = 0 (unlimited).
#   
#                           Restart firewall after making changes.
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malicious data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
